span.p:
`inner` is untyped/duck-typed: any object with
plan()/layers()/build()/root — not a real type
dependency on a specific builder class. Dashed
arrows here show the recommended stack
AtomicBuilder(CacheBuilder(IncrementalBuilder(...))),
not a compile-time constraint.
